study type: Retrospective analysis and prospective physician survey
exposure: vaginal examination to verify fetal presentation
Method of fetal presentation detection (abdominal palpation, vaginal examination)
cohort: Pregnant women at a busy maternity clinic
finding: The current practice of using a vaginal examination to verify fetal presentation determined by abdominal palpation may not be more accurate than abdominal palpation alone, resulting in an unacceptably high rate (8%) of missed breech presentations.
